Create management input file for 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/make_inputs.R
make_management.Rd

make_management writes the site_management.txt file used by the model when man = "var": years of thinning (and their intensity), harvesting and regeneration.

Usage

make_management(
  site,
  thinning = NULL,
  thinning_int = NULL,
  harvesting = NULL,
  regeneration = NULL,
  outdir
)

Arguments

site

Character: Name of the site. Used to construct output name

thinning

Integer vector: years of thinning. Default to NULL

thinning_int

Numeric vector: intensity of each thinning (\ area removed). If NULL the parameter THINNING_INTENSITY of the species file is used. Default to NULL

harvesting

Integer vector: years of harvesting. Default to NULL

regeneration

Integer vector: years of regeneration. Default to NULL

outdir

Character: path to the output directory.

Value

Invisibly, a named list with the management actions. The file site_management.txt is saved in outdir.

See also

run_3DCMCCFEM, check_inputs

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
make_management("BilyKriz", thinning = c(2030, 2060, 2090),
                thinning_int = c(30, 20, 10), harvesting = 2102,
                regeneration = 2103, outdir = tempdir())
} # }
